description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade functions and checks for Mikrotik routers in the OpenWrt project. It includes functions to verify images, perform upgrades on NAND storage, and decide upgrade procedures based on device type.

methods.name: platform_check_image_mikrotik_nor
methods.description: Checks the RouterBOOT version and image type compatibility.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Determines whether a given image is suitable for the current device based on device-specific checks.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_mikrotik_nand
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process on Mikrotik devices with NAND storage.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade procedure selecting appropriate methods based on device type.
